syntax_quirks: clipped clauses instead of compound sentences

subtext_behavior.when_lying: Over-explains sensory details — colors, smells, sounds — to build false texture
subtext_behavior.when_angry: Drops to 3-5 word clipped fragments, nearly monosyllabic
subtext_behavior.when_desperate: Speaks faster, strings clauses with dashes, drops all articles
subtext_behavior.when_guarded: Deflects with dry maritime analogies, never answers directly
subtext_behavior.when_mocking: Echoes the other speaker's words back in a sing-song paraphrase

backstory: Ran freight through contested waters for fifteen years before the port authority burned his license. Now he moves what needs moving and doesn't ask what's in the crates. Trusts exactly two people, and one of them is dead.
